mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_no, user_id, merchant_id, order_amount, delivery_fee, discount_amount, actual_amount, order_status, payment_method, delivery_address, contact_phone, remark, order_time, pay_time, complete_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{merchantId}, #{orderAmount}, #{deliveryFee}, #{discountAmount}, #{actualAmount}, #{orderStatus}, #{paymentMethod}, #{deliveryAddress}, #{contactPhone}, #{remark}, #{orderTime}, #{payTime}, #{completeTime})
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN actual_amount < 30 THEN '0-30元' WHEN actual_amount < 50 THEN '30-50元' WHEN actual_amount < 100 THEN '50-100元' ELSE '100元以上' END AS price_range, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_status IN (2, 4) GROUP BY price_range
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM orders WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
